accounting.ceiling_arithmetic: 2,600 = 200 rows x 13 and 52 = 4 rows x 13, where 13 is the grouped-Solver graph's OWN ceiling at samples 2 as rails.native_episode_config.load_native_episode_config resolves it: perception.max_iterations + (max_revisions + 1) x (solver.max_iterations x solver.samples + reviewer.max_iterations + planner.max_iterations) = 1 + 2 x (1 x 2 + 3 + 1). Verified offline at registration: the composed program phase-native-candidates-review-revise-samples2-v1 declares max_contacts 13 and the loader's own graph ceiling resolves to 13 (a disagreement is refused by name).
accounting.expected_spend: About 5.2 contacts per row, so about 1,040 contacts and about 0.4 GPU hours on the arm. Basis: cell CELL-1 measured 4.216 contacts per row on the same four-node graph at samples 1 (docs/readiness/2026-09-24-slurp-stage3-delta-cell-gepa-r01-v1/registered-facts-v1.json, predecessor_read), and a two-sample Solver group spends exactly one extra contact per Solver visit; the throughput basis is the L1 geometry's measured 1.79 GPU-hours per 1,080 rows at about 4 contacts per row (docs/results, serving-geometry findings 2026-09-19). The registered ceiling is therefore about 2.5x the expected contacts and about 5x the expected GPU hours. A ceiling is a BOUND, never a target, and budgets are run-cumulative across every attempt of a run id.
accounting.speech_arithmetic: 10,235 = ceil(787.2898125 x 13) on the 200 arm rows and 222 = ceil(17.034937499999998 x 13) on the four smoke rows. The per-row audio seconds are read from the committed R01C runtime view's own items[].audio_seconds; no audio sample was decoded to obtain them.

decision_rule.h_within_definition: h_within := the CI95 half-width of the pooled micro paired delta (sample 1 minus sample 0) of official SLU-F1 over the 200 rows, by row bootstrap, 10,000 draws, seed 20260915. Its intent sibling h_within_intent is the same quantity for scenario_action_exact. They are DESCRIPTIVE outputs, not gates.
decision_rule.no_gate_number: No threshold is pre-registered on any number this cell produces, because it carries no admission verdict. A structural defect (a row without exactly two custodied samples, a malformed sample, a dropped row, a tools array) stops the arm and is root-caused; it is not a measured result.
decision_rule.rule: DESCRIPTIVE. Nothing is admitted, rejected or locked by this cell. It produces ONE number the program then uses as a registered margin: h_within, the within-flight paired half-width at n = 200, which every ROLL-2 variant comparison at n = 200 is read against. Structural acceptance for the flight itself is: a clean seal, 200 of 200 rows delivered, exactly two custodied samples per row in solver_group (invariant I7g), the plurality-commit replay of saea-commit-plurality-support-v1 over the raw samples reproducing the sealed delivered answer, zero native task-contract calls, and every request fitting.
decision_rule.what_a_large_h_within_would_mean: If h_within at n = 200 is not materially smaller than the CROSS-FLIGHT half-widths the program already carries (Fold A h_SLU 1.2485 / h_intent 0.9943; DEV-2000-ADDED h_SLU 1.2525 / h_intent 1.1520 -- both at n >= 1,080), then paired within-flight rollouts buy no precision over separate flights and ROLL-2 must be read at n well above 200. That negative outcome is a RESULT of this cell, not a failure of it, and it is reported as such.

diagnostics_required: ROW ACCOUNTING: 200 in, 200 out; no row dropped and no sample_id invented.

SAMPLE CUSTODY: exactly 2 samples in solver_group per row (invariant I7g), each with its own sample_index, seed and temperature; the two seeds must be 2080141211 and 2080141212 and both temperatures must be 0.0 on every row -- the registered proof that the flight really flew the A/A form.
BYTE-IDENTICAL SHARE: the fraction of rows whose two raw Solver responses are byte-identical, with its denominator. This is the headline descriptive number beside h_within.
INTENT-FLIP SHARE: the fraction of rows whose two samples disagree on (scenario, action).
ENTITY-SET-FLIP SHARE: the fraction of rows whose two samples disagree on the set of (type, filler) pairs after the registered normalisation.
PAIRED DELTA DISTRIBUTION: mean, standard deviation and CI95 half-width of the per-row paired official SLU-F1 delta and of the intent delta, by row bootstrap, 10,000 draws, seed 20260915.

COMMIT EFFECT: how often the min_support-2 commit delivered an answer that differs from BOTH samples (an intersection effect), reported as a count -- the delivered answer is not the measured quantity but its divergence from the samples must be visible.
PER-STRATUM TABLE: the paired delta by scenario stratum, in the natural-mixture weighting, with the 9-stratum coverage of this roster stated beside it.
COST: contacts per row realised, GPU hours, prefilled tokens per row, and the revision share (how often the Planner returned REVISE and a second grouped Solver visit occurred).

not_claimed: NO SUPERIORITY, GENERALISATION, COMPONENT-CAUSAL, BAR, HELD-OUT OR PAPER-SCALE CLAIM OF ANY KIND. The construction roster is exposed development data (owner decisions 28, 86).

NO CLAIM THAT h_within TRANSFERS to another roster, another population size, another geometry, another serving session or another sample count. It is measured at n = 200 on nine scenario strata of R01C, on the np4 x 24,576 SLURP geometry, at samples 2.
NO CLAIM ABOUT THE GROUPED SOLVER'S TASK QUALITY. A null measures noise, not effect.

NO CLAIM THAT A ZERO PAIRED DELTA MEANS DETERMINISM. llama.cpp greedy decoding is not bitwise reproducible across batch compositions; a byte-identical share below 1.0 is the expected outcome and is the quantity being measured.

purpose: Cell ROLL-AA (board route F2): measure the WITHIN-FLIGHT paired noise floor of the Stage-3 variant-rollout methodology. The locked v2.0 plan's Solver answers the IDENTICAL prompt TWICE for each of 200 R01C construction rows inside ONE flight, greedy (temperature 0, the E2b twin 'greedy-repeat' form), and the offline read reports the per-row paired difference between the two samples. Because the two sides are two contacts of one request, whatever difference appears is the measurement floor itself -- batch-composition nondeterminism -- and its CI95 half-width becomes h_within, the margin every ROLL-2 variant comparison at n = 200 is read against.
quality_gate: No read of any kind before the complete sealed manifest, the exact ordered 200 outputs with exactly two custodied solver_group samples per row (invariant I7g) and the native phase summary all exist. There is no admission read. A partial manifest is never read and a failed smoke stops the arm.

stage3_algorithm.note: Stage-3 algorithm label (owner decision 101): shared-rollout, operator rollout. ROLL-AA exercises the SAME algorithm-neutral rollout substrate cell ROLL-1 registered -- the grouped Solver, its custody and its commit -- and applies no learned context of its own. It is the A/A NULL of that substrate, which is why it carries the substrate's own label and no family label; it uses neither credit_assignment nor update.
